developmentChanges.title: Persistent candidate state ledger
developmentChanges.reason: Persist each discovered candidate with stable ID, lifecycle state (seen, verified, promotion-ready, live, rejected), lastSeenAt, rejection reason and nextRecheckAt so repeated hourly runs do not re-evaluate the same evidence from scratch and do not accidentally create sibling duplicates.

developmentChanges.title: Effective hourly value normalizer with commute and application friction
developmentChanges.reason: Normalize monthly, part-time, hourly and fixed-price work into a comparable effective hourly value using scheduled hours, expected commute burden and application/platform friction. This makes a 4-hour local admin role directly comparable with full-time onsite and remote freelance work without overvaluing headline monthly pay.
